witness.branch: Opposing simultaneous left turns at a two-directional-to-two-directional intersection.
witness.quote: simultaneous left turns by opposing traffic must be made in front of each other.
witness.reason: The fixed intersection and left turn support the operative movement if both highways are undivided and opposing traffic also turns left simultaneously.
required_context: Both intersecting highways are undivided and permit opposite-direction travel.
Establish both highways as undivided and permitting opposite-direction travel, and give the opposing vehicle an intended and actual left turn.
Establish qualifying highway and intersection status, driver control and vehicle classification.
Identify the physically controlling driver and included vehicles; establish public-highway and qualifying non-alley intersection status.
Inventory applicable official devices and establish whether their actual directions engage the exception.

Inventory potentially applicable official devices, their actual instructions, states, timing and placement authority; preserve unresolved legal qualification and determine whether any direction is contrary to the default movement.
Retain synchronized paths, headings, relative bearings and timing before, during and after both turns without defining simultaneity or 'in front of each other'.
The other vehicle approaches from the opposing direction and makes a simultaneous left turn.
